αἰχμὴ: αἰχμή — spear-point, spear; fem. nom. sg.: ’the point’
αἰόλον: αἰόλος — glancing, quick-moving (sheen or colour uncertain); adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴαντε: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. dual nom./acc.: ’the two Ajaxes’ (the Telamonian and the Locrian)
αὐτάων: αὐτός — self, same; in the oblique cases ’him, her, it, them’; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic αὐτῶν): ’them’
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.

αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)

αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)

βάλλον: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλλον): ’were throwing’
βίηφι: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental in -φι (= dat. βίῃ): ’in might, by force’
βουλέων: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)
βουλῇ: βουλή — counsel, plan, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐν βουλῇ ’in council’) · also fem. dat. sg. of respect, no preposition: ’in counsel’ (βουλῇ … ἄριστος ’best in counsel’) · also fem. dat. sg., object of πείθομαι: ’counsel’ (βουλῇ … πίθοντο ’obeyed the counsel’)

γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δάμασον: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, tame, master; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δάμασσε: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- and unaugmented (= Attic ἐδάμασε): ’subdued’
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαναοὶ: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δειρὴν: δειρή — neck, throat; fem. acc. sg., epic -ὴν (= Attic δέρην)
δηΐους: δήϊος — hostile, enemy; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic δῄους), agreeing with ἄνδρας: ’hostile men’
δηϊοτῆτα: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, battle (δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. acc. sg., epic
δηϊοτῆτος: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, combat (cf. δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. gen. sg., stem δηϊοτῆτ-
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
δοκεῖ: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., impersonal with dat. and inf.: ’it seems (to me)’
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δράκοντα: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. acc. sg.
δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic δοῦναι) · also inf. as imperative: ’let (them) give back’ (σῶμα … δόμεναι)
δώῃσιν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic δῷ); with κε in a condition: ’gives up’
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῃώσωσιν: δηϊόω (δῃόω) — cut down, slay; aor. subj. 3 pl., ν-movable, after εἴ κεν
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.

εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἴτ: εἴτε — whether, either; conj., elided (εἴτ’ = εἴτε)
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
εἷς: εἷς — one; numeral, masc. nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζηνὸς: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. gen. sg., alternate stem Ζην- (beside Δι-)
ζωστῆρα: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. acc. sg.
ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic ζωός (= Attic ζῶν)
ζωὸν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν): ’alive’
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’they laid, stowed’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, divine, beyond mortal scale; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by a wondrous (power)’
θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with ἀνδράσι
θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic κέλῃ)
κέλεσθε: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’bid!’
κέλευθα: κέλευθος — path, way; neut. acc. pl. κέλευθα (Homeric neuter plural of a masc. noun)
κατένευσε: κατανεύω — nod assent, grant by a nod; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound (κατ-έ-νευσε): ’nodded assent’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’)
κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λίθον: ’lying’
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg. act.
κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, path; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation after ἀπόεικε: ’from the road’

κολεοῖο: κολεός — sheath, scabbard; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
κράτος: κράτος — strength, power, might; neut. acc. sg. (object of τίθει) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’power, might’ (τοῦ κράτος ἐστὶ μέγιστον) · also neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive in indirect statement: ’that the strength is great’ (μέγα … κράτος εἶναι ’that the strength is great’)
κραδίη: κραδίη — heart; fem. nom. sg. (= Attic καρδία)
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
κυνέης: κυνέη — helmet, cap (properly of dog-skin); fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κυνῆς)
κόψε: κόπτω — strike, cut; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκοψε): ’struck’
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’
λαοί: λαός — people, host, the men of an army; masc. nom. pl.
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λεοντεὺς: Λεοντεύς — Leonteus, joint leader with Polypoetes, son of Coronus; masc. nom. sg.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντήσειε: ’meet (in) battle’ (μάχης ἀντήσειε ’would meet in battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἄρχε: ’(begin) the battle’ (ἄρχε μάχης ’begin the fight’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of παυσώμεσθα: ’cease from battle’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with σχήσεσθαι: ’from battle’ (or governed by μεμαώς: ’eager for battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀπέληγε: ’from (the fighting)’ (ἀπέληγε μάχης ’left off the fighting’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἐπιτάρροθοι: ’helpers in battle’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέμασαν: μέμονα — be eager, be set on; 3 pl., perfect stem with past sense, epic, + inf.: ’were eager’

μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μέσσοισι: μέσος — middle, mid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι with double σ (= Attic μέσοις); ἐν μέσσοισι ’in the midst’
μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc. dat. sg. used as a noun: ἐν μέσῳ ’in the middle, in the midst’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. μαρμαίροντα: μαρμαίρω — flash, sparkle; pres. part. act., neut. acc. pl.: ’flashing’
μαχησόμενοι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); fut. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’about to fight, to fight’ (of purpose)
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεθιέντα: μεθίημι — let go, slacken; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’slackening’
μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; adj., neut. dat. pl., agreeing with ἐπέεσσιν
μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’)
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
ναῦφιν: ναῦς — ship; pl. with epic suffix -φιν, ablatival (’from the ships’; = Attic νεῶν)
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, think, consider; aor. inf. act.: οἶδε νοῆσαι ’knows how to consider’
νόον: νόος — mind, understanding; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦν)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
ξίφος: ξίφος — sword; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., as subject (ξίφος ἄγη ’the sword was broken’)
οἰκί: οἰκίον — dwelling, home; neut. pl. οἰκία (acc. pl.), elided (οἰκί’ = οἰκία)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔδει: οὖδας — ground, floor (Attic ἔδαφος); neut. dat. sg. οὔδει (also οὔδεϊ): ’on the floor’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’) · also relative, object of ἑλόμην: ’which’ (of horses)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντοσε: πάντοσε — in every direction, all round; adv.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πέλασε: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπέλασε): ’brought down (to)’
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’ · also intensive after ὅτε, accented before τε: ’just when’ · also intensive after εἰ, accented before the enclitic τε: ’if indeed’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ ’if a man indeed notices’)
παραστάς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
παρὲξ: παρέξ — out beyond, past, outside; prep. + acc. (also an adverb)
πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
πειριθόου: Πειρίθοος — Peirithous, king of the Lapiths; masc. gen. sg.
πεπάλακτο: παλάσσω — splash, spatter, besmear; plpf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’was spattered’
πεποιθότες: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, trust (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’trusting in’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
πλεῖστοι: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, masc. nom. pl.: ’in the greatest numbers’
πλῆξ: πλήσσω — strike; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (πλῆξ’ = πλῆξε, Attic ἔπληξε): ’struck’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολυποίτης: Πολυποίτης — Polypoetes, son of Peirithous and joint leader with Leonteus; masc. nom. sg.
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’)
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
πουλυδάμαντι: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντι)
πουλυδάμας: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, Trojan counsellor; masc. nom. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Attic Πολυδάμας)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πύργων: πύργος — tower, wall-tower; masc. gen. pl., after ἐπιβήσεαι (+ gen.) · also masc. gen. pl., after ἐπί: ’on the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on ὅμαδος and δοῦπος: ’of towers being struck’ · also masc. gen. pl., dependent on δούρατα: ’of the towers’ · also masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the towers’
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς before a following enclitic (οἱ): ’lest somehow’
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σθένεϊ: σθένος — strength, might; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic σθένει): ’in strength’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπουδῆς: σπουδή — haste, effort, earnestness; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπό: ’in earnest’
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάφρῳ: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. dat. sg.
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)
τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’ · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition to a noun: ’a portent’
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεκέεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέκνοις)
τεράεσσι: τέρας — portent, sign; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέρασι)
τερπικέραυνος: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg.
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. τοί (= Attic οἱ), used as a relative: ’who’ · also τοί = τοι, encl. dat. of σύ: ’to you’ (κασίγνητος δέ τοί εἰμι ’I am your brother’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’)
τοῦδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc./neut. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than this’
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυπεὶς: τύπτω — strike; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’struck, wounded’
τυχήσας: τυγχάνω — hit (+ gen.), hit upon, meet with; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., aor. in -ησα: ’having hit’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’own’ (φίλα εἵματα ’his own clothes’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’dear’ (φίλα τέκνα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as adverb: φίλα φρονέων ’kindly disposed’ · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’own, dear’ (φίλα γούνατα ’my own knees’)
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing; with the opt., potential: ’would’ · also with the subj. after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ χ’ … πύθηαι ’if you ever hear’)
χάζοντο: χάζομαι — give ground, draw back, yield (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐχάζοντο)
χάρμης: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. gen. sg.
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χαμᾶζε: χαμᾶζε — to the ground, down to earth; adv. (χαμαί + -δε)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
ἀγορευέμεν: ἀγορεύω — speak, tell; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic -εύειν), used as an imperative: ’tell!’
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard, + acc. of what is said); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard’
ἀλγήσας: ἀλγέω — feel pain, suffer; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having felt pain’
ἀλεγίζω: ἀλεγίζω — pay heed to, care for (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg., usually with a negative
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμείνονα: ἀμείνων — better; comparative of ἀγαθός; masc. acc. sg.
ἀμυνόμενοι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; mid. pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’defending themselves, defending’
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’ · also masc. nom. dual, in apposition to a dual subject (τὼ … ἀμφοτέρω ’the two, both’)
ἀμύνεσθαι: ἀμύνω — ward off; mid. defend oneself; pres. inf. mid.: ’to defend oneself’
ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀντιμάχοιο: Ἀντίμαχος — Antimachus, a Trojan, father of Peisander and Hippolochus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι ’perish’; aor. mid. inf.: ’to perish’

ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
ἀστεροπητὴς: ἀστεροπητής — lightener, wielder of lightning; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἄριστα: ἀγαθός (superl. ἄριστος) — best; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’best’ · also neut. nom. pl., predicate with εἶναι: ’best’ (ἄριστα … εἶναι ’(things) to be best’)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅπας: ἅπας — all, the whole of, entirely; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’; not the possessive
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκτελέεσθαι: ἐκτελέω — accomplish, bring about; inf. mid./pass., epic uncontracted -έεσθαι (= Attic -εῖσθαι), after ἔλπομαι: ’to be brought about’

ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)

ἐξενάριξεν: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of arms, kill and despoil; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’killed and stripped’
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπασσυτέρους: ἐπασσύτερος — one close upon another, in quick succession; adj., masc. acc. pl.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’)
ἐπῆλθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, pass over, arrive; aor. 3 sg. (same form in Attic)
ἐρείσθη: ἐρείδω — prop, press, thrust; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was driven down’
ἐριγδούποιο: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, loud-thundering; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Zeus, epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having drawn (a sword)’
ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.: ’good things, good deeds’
ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν ’if truly’)
ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
ἐφεσταότες: ἐφίστημι — stand upon; perf. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic -αότες (= Attic ἐφεστηκότες): ’standing upon’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔντεα: ἔντεα — gear, implements, equipment; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the gear’ (ἔντεα κεῖται ’the gear lies’)
ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ (+ dat.: βασιλῆϊ … ἔοικε ’is like a king’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
ἕθεν: ἕ, οὗ — of himself, him, her; 3 sg. pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ); with πρόσθεν, πρό: ’in front of him’, reflexive ’in front of himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from himself’ (ἀπὸ ἕθεν … ὤσατο ’pushed away from himself’) · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’for his sake’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question · also ἠέ, ’or’, introducing a further alternative in a list (ἠέ ποθι ’or somewhere’) · also ἠέ, ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠέ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’) · also ἠέ, ’than’, after a verb of wishing, with no comparative: ’rather than’ (δοῦναι κράτος ἠέ περ ἡμῖν ’to give strength rather than to us’)
ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε, with ὑπό: ’beneath the sun’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠερόεντα: ἠερόεις — misty, murky, dim (ἠήρ ’mist’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Τάρταρον
ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; fem. acc. sg., with ὑπό: ’beneath the dawn’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ τ’ ἠέλιόν τε ’under dawn and sun’) · also fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ δῖαν φανήμεναι ’that heavenly Dawn appear’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of μίμνω: ’Dawn’ (Ἠῶ μίμνον ’waited for Dawn’)
ἡγήσατο: ἡγέομαι — lead, be leader (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid. dep.: ’led’
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’) · also with ἐξ in tmesis: ’sent out’ (ἐξ … ἧκε = ἐξῆκε) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’sent in, let loose among’ (ἐν … κυδοιμὸν ἧκε ’sent uproar among’)
ἰαμενὸν: Ἰάμενος — Iamenus, a Trojan warrior; masc. acc. sg.
ἰδαίων: Ἰδαῖος — of Ida, Idaean; adj. gen. pl., agreeing with ὀρέων
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us go’
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀδύνῃσι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ὀδύναις)
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀνύχεσσι: ὄνυξ — claw, talon; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -ξι)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρέστην: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg.
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀστέον: ὀστέον — bone; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὀστοῦν)
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὁμοῖοι: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’like’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄζος: ὄζος — branch, shoot; fig. scion, offshoot; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρμενον: Ὄρμενος — Ormenus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’) · also ’so that’ + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν ’so that they might pass through’) · also temporal, ’when, as soon as’ + aor. indic. (ὅπως ἴδον ’when they saw’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’)
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’destroyed’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥήξειν: ῥήγνυμι — break, shatter; fut. inf. act.: ’to break’
